title: UTC Event Entry Mode & Real-Time Local Time Conversion Engine
notes: Added native UTC date and time inputs to the Scheduled Countdown Alert Creator with instant live conversion to local timezone.
Integrated quick UTC preset buttons (00:00, 02:00 Reset, 06:00 Patch, 12:00, 19:00 Bear Trap) for effortless event scheduling.
Added seamless two-way synchronization between Game UTC and Local time modes.
